terra.problem: The text says the lords spoke, not that they sang, and it does not say they were scared of Samson.
“No rain in this party” asserts weather the text does not describe.
The claim that nobody in the temple asked Samson to carry a tray adds a detail the text does not give.
The text does not say what anyone in the crowd was thinking about the pillars.
The crowd's size does not establish that there was little room to hide.
Samson gives a reason for reaching the pillars, but the text does not say whether he wanted to hear the crowd better.
“His chains” assumes Samson was still wearing shackles at the temple; this passage does not say that.
His family carries him back for burial, but the passage does not say they take him home.
The grinding is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference. Comparing Samson's statement about dying to a nap is also too light for the moment.
Samson prayed for strength to pay back the Philistines for his eyes; the text does not say he prayed for the temple to fall.
The passage says Samson's family carried him back for burial, not that they took him home.
The statement that Samson had been imprisoned in Gaza is from outside this passage and needs a reference.
